findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards all recorded logs
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a brand-new NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver (or a logger sharing the receiver's state). LoggerMiddleware.logRequest now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so any test that injects a TestLogger and then asserts on that instance's InfoLogs/WarnLogs/etc. will observe zero calls because the log record was written to a throwaway instance. FromContext should return f (or a logger sharing f's Logs) so the fake remains usable for assertions.

findings.title: "Plugin Request Completed" log loses its traceID field
findings.body: The old logRequest explicitly appended "traceID" from tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) to every completion log. This change removes that code, and neither the replacement path (grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext in pkg/plugins/log/logger.go, which only converts the infra logger returned by FromContext) nor the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware.instrumentContext (which only sets endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname) adds a traceID attribute. As a result the 'Plugin Request Completed' log line no longer carries traceID, breaking log-to-trace correlation that existed before; the traceID must be re-added either in logRequest or in instrumentContext.
